title: Printable Christmas Cards, Robin at the Frosted Gate, Two Designs, Traditional Card Set, Instant Download
description:
Send a little cosy Christmas warmth to friends, family or neighbours this season. Robin at the Frosted Gate brings a tender, nostalgic feeling to a heartfelt festive greeting. ❄️

With its quietly magical mood and refined handmade feel, this Christmas card set offers a thoughtful way to share warm wishes. The cards have a traditional seasonal character that feels personal and unhurried. ✨

Choose your design

Merry Christmas features the front text “Merry Christmas”.

Christmas Wishes offers a second design option.

Both designs share the inside message: “Wishing you a joyful Christmas and a happy New Year”.

What you receive

• Two Christmas card designs: Merry Christmas and Christmas Wishes
• Shared inside message for both designs
• A4 PDF files
• US Letter PDF files
• 4×6 in card panels
• Folded card size from A4: 124 × 186 mm
• Folded card size from US Letter: 128 × 192 mm
• 3 original artwork PNG files
• Printing guide

How it works

Download the ZIP, choose your preferred design, print using your chosen format, then fold and send your Christmas wishes. The included printing guide is there to help with the process. 🎄

A warm card can say so much at Christmas. Share this gentle seasonal greeting with friends, family or neighbours, and let the message carry your good wishes into the New Year.

This is an instant digital download of PDF and PNG files. No physical item is shipped.
